Variable (depends on the state of the lake; fish once every 20 h)

The {wiki:Lake Equivocolao}, north of Port Hope, is the only place where the rare {item:Shimmer Swimmer} lives, but the fish only appears when the lake is filthy. The server's players throw corpses into the lake; after 1000 corpses, the lake becomes dirty at the next server save and you can try to fish a Shimmer Swimmer. After 50 you get the achievement **Biodegradable**.
Lake Equivocolao, north of Port Hope
